card.name: WordPress comment-form notify text
card.fires_on: Words inside the WordPress comment footer line 'Notify me of follow-up comments via email. Notify me of new posts via email', especially 'of' and 'via'. Weaker on scattered words before 'active', 'are' or 'jobs'.

modes.label: Comment-form notify line
modes.description: Words in the 'Notify me of follow-up comments via email' checkbox text after the social login prompts.

modes.label: Scattered technical words
modes.description: Occasional words before a state or verb in instructions or manuals, such as 'Paths' or 'jobs'.
modes.example: using the Pen Tool with<< Paths>> active.

card.writes: Weakly promotes setting-style words like verbosity and enable, suggesting a configuration-option continuation.
card.plain: It lights up on the stock 'Notify me of follow-up comments via email' text at the bottom of blog comment forms.
